name: Thijs Reuten - § 49 - Am 12
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 49. Deplores the recent substantial defence expenditure increases; stresses that the use of EU programmes and funds, such as EDF, EDIP, ReARM and SAFE, to amplify the build-up of military industrial sectors violates Article 41(2) TEU, which prohibits spending from the EU budget for military purposes; opposes the militarisation of the EU and the establishment of a military union;
